rationale_summary: The document's dominant rationale is economic competitiveness: its preamble, industry status analysis, and overarching goals frame AI standardization primarily as a strategic lever to cultivate 'new quality productive forces,' upgrade manufacturing, build China into a manufacturing and digital powerhouse, seize first-mover advantage in the AI industry, and expand global industrial influence. Innovation enablement is a strong secondary frame, as the guide emphasizes innovation-driven linkages between R&D and standards, enterprise adoption, and scenario-based deployment across sectors; however, economic competitiveness edges it out because technological innovation and standard adoption are explicitly subordinated to national industrial upgrading and global market positioning. Consumer and public safety appears as a modest secondary frame through full-lifecycle product, system, and operational safety standards intended to underpin secure industrial development, while fairness and explainability appear only briefly under ethical governance standards.

evidence_spans.quote_en: Artificial intelligence is a foundational and strategic technology leading a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation; it is becoming an important engine for developing new quality productive forces, accelerating deep integration with the real economy, comprehensively empowering new industrialization, profoundly changing industrial production modes and economic development forms, and playing an important supporting role in accelerating the building of a manufacturing powerhouse, cyber powerhouse, and Digital China.
